# Architecture Decision Records

| ID | Title | Status | Date | Summary |

| [0001](0001-use-a-local-ollama-vision-model.md) | Use a local Ollama vision model rather than a hosted description API | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | Descriptions come from a vision model served by a local Ollama, because the workload is high-volume and includes images hosted services refuse. |
| [0002](0002-use-stdlib-urllib-as-the-transport.md) | Use stdlib urllib as the transport instead of the ollama client library | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The three JSON POSTs the library makes are written against urllib.request, keeping Pillow the only runtime dependency and letting the tests drive a real HTTP server. |
| [0003](0003-image-in-string-out-failures-are-exceptions.md) | Image in, string out, every failure an exception | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | describe() returns a plain str and raises on every failure, with one exception hierarchy rooted at DescribeItError and TypeError/ValueError reserved for caller mistakes. |
| [0004](0004-default-to-qwen35-4b.md) | Default to the qwen3.5:4b vision model | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The packaged default model is qwen3.5:4b, chosen for refusal resistance over caption quality, and overridable with $DESCRIBE_IT_MODEL. |
| [0005](0005-prepare-images-as-rgb-jpeg-over-white.md) | Prepare every image as an RGB JPEG flattened onto white | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Any PIL mode is accepted and normalised in one place — EXIF orientation, alpha and colour keys flattened onto white, LANCZOS downscale to 1024, JPEG quality 90 — and the caller's image is never mutated. |
| [0006](0006-clean-replies-and-guard-the-refusal-heuristic.md) | Clean the model's reply to a fixed point, and guard the refusal heuristic | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Replies are stripped of labels, quotes, markdown and think blocks until they stop changing, and a refusal is detected only when a refusal phrase starts a short or run-on reply. |
| [0007](0007-send-think-false-and-fixed-sampling-options.md) | Send think:false unconditionally, with temperature 0.2 and num_predict as a stop | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Every chat request carries think:false without a capability probe, temperature 0.2, and num_predict = max_words * 4 + 32 as a safety stop rather than a length control. |
| [0008](0008-build-a-private-opener-and-mirror-ollamas-host-rules.md) | Build a private urllib opener that ignores proxies and does not follow redirects | Accepted | 2026-08-20 | Each client builds its own OpenerDirector with an empty ProxyHandler and no redirect handler, and host strings are normalised the way Ollama's own CLI reads $OLLAMA_HOST. |
| [0009](0009-never-pull-a-model-implicitly.md) | Never pull a model implicitly | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | A describe call against a missing model raises ModelNotFoundError naming the `ollama pull` command; downloading is only ever done by an explicit ensure_model() call. |
| [0010](0010-gate-on-a-hermetic-suite-and-keep-live-tests-opt-in.md) | Gate CI on a hermetic suite at 100% coverage, with live tests opt-in | Accepted | 2026-08-19 | The merge gate is a hermetic unit suite at 100% line and branch coverage; tests against a real model are opt-in, non-blocking, and assert structure only. |
